subject: Competition?
author: ichienkai
body:
Raptor ive sent you a couple of ideas where you can join tourneys if you want to do that man - i think its a great idea though to have some sort of thing goin with some of the members of this site who so far have proved to be great Burners and great individuals.  Some of us though have the attention span of a goldfish so if someone can come up with an idea we best keep it short (no 10 laps on the Mountain in 160's!) subject: Burnoutcrash.com Competitions
author: hn6
body:
The crash competitions were going strong up until about a month ago, then halo 3 came out. A lot of the crashing community are still off on halo 3, half-life and others. You can still get a ladder match at some point of the day.

 

50 Hurtz

subject: Tourneys and Contests
author: ZombieTron
body:
Revenge has had its fair share of Tournaments, Xbox Live Addicts used to run a Burnout Revenge Leage. A few other Tournaments have been attempted over at the Xbox.com forums. And BurnoutCrash.com regularly runs Crash Tourneys (I believe).

If any of our members want to set up a Tournament we are happy to help with formats and space on the site for league tables etc. But we do not have the time or motivation to run any tournaments ourselves! (and I am notoriously lazy!!)

We do have some ideas for contests for Burnout Paradise however, so keep your eyes open for those in the new year! 🙂

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Tournaments...
author: FrozenVapor
body: I think Phil's Fall racing tournament was organized very well... we'll have see if it turns out okay though. TBH it's very hard to get a tournament going for a game this old, and I think he made a good effort. If this site holds any race/crash tourneys I'll be sure to join just for the fun
